The experience taught David more than any book could. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. She spat the apple pip into her hand.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. David plans to study science harder this term. On Friday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. Also, she walked briskly to catch the bus.

David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. There are always more possibilities than we expect. My father-in-law fixed the fence.
Little by little, things began to change. David thanked Lily for the honest advice. David wrote down every idea in a small notebook. They sampled honey mead at the medieval festival.
David is saving money to buy a ticket to Toronto. People around David often share different ideas about the moon-lit yard. David prefers rainy weather when running in the gym.
